name: invoice_report
prompt:
Here is a Renyi program. It is run with the command-line arguments [] and no other input. Output exactly what the program prints to standard output, and nothing else: no explanation, no code fences.

module invoice_report
  purpose: Print a plain-text statement for several invoices, reusing the invoice module.

import std.console
import invoice exposing Invoice, Line

public function statement_line(order: Invoice) returns Text
  purpose: One row of the statement: customer, number of lines and total, in fixed columns.
  example: statement_line(Invoice(customer: "ACME", lines: [], discount_percent: 0))
    is "ACME          0 lines      0.00"

  let customer be order.customer.pad_right(12)
  let line_count be order.lines.length().to_text().pad_left(3)
  let total be invoice.total(order).to_text().pad_left(10)
  return "{customer}{line_count} lines{total}"
end

public function grand_total(orders: List of Invoice) returns Decimal
  purpose: The sum of every invoice total.
  example: grand_total([]) is 0

  return for each order in orders sum invoice.total(order)
end

public function main() needs console
  purpose: Print a statement for two sample invoices and their grand total.

  let orders be [
    Invoice(
      customer: "ACME",
      lines: [Line(description: "pen", quantity: 10, unit_price: 1.00)],
      discount_percent: 10
    ),
    Invoice(
      customer: "Globex",
      lines: [
        Line(description: "notebook", quantity: 2, unit_price: 4.50),
        Line(description: "stapler", quantity: 1, unit_price: 12.00)
      ],
      discount_percent: 0
    )
  ]
  for each order in orders sorted by order.customer
    console.print(statement_line(order))
  end
  console.print("grand total: {grand_total(orders)}")
end

The program imports the module `invoice`, which is this file:

module invoice
  purpose: Compute invoice totals with a percentage discount, exact to the cent.

public type Line
  purpose: One billable line of an invoice.
  has description: Text
  has quantity: Integer where quantity is at least 1
  has unit_price: Decimal where unit_price is at least 0
end

public type Invoice
  purpose: A set of lines billed to one customer.
  has customer: Text
  has lines: List of Line
  has discount_percent: Decimal
    where discount_percent is at least 0
    and discount_percent is at most 100
end

public function line_total(line: Line) returns Decimal
  purpose: Quantity times unit price for one line.
  example: line_total(Line(description: "pen", quantity: 3, unit_price: 1.50)) is 4.50

  return line.quantity.to_decimal() * line.unit_price
end

public function subtotal(invoice: Invoice) returns Decimal
  purpose: Sum of all line totals before the discount.
  see also: total

  return for each line in invoice.lines sum line_total(line)
end

public function total(invoice: Invoice) returns Decimal
  purpose: Subtotal after the percentage discount, rounded to cents.
  see also: subtotal

  let before_discount be subtotal(invoice)
  let discount be before_discount * invoice.discount_percent / 100
  return (before_discount - discount).rounded(2)
end

test "a ten percent discount is taken from the subtotal"
  let pens be Line(description: "pen", quantity: 10, unit_price: 1.00)
  let order be Invoice(customer: "ACME", lines: [pens], discount_percent: 10)
  check subtotal(order) is 10.00
  check total(order) is 9.00
end

test "an invoice without lines totals zero"
  let empty be Invoice(customer: "ACME", lines: [], discount_percent: 0)
  check total(empty) is 0
end
